name: microgreen-canopy
title: Microgreen Canopy
subtitle: Whole-tray cover, greenness and evenness
description: Tray-level metrics for stands too dense to segment into individuals: canopy cover, greenness, spatial evenness and a combined readiness score. One summary row per image.
method: HSB conversion; canopy = hue 50-110 AND saturation >= 40, so unsaturated tray edges are excluded. Greenness is mean hue distance from green measured on an unmodified copy of the hue channel. Uniformity is 1 - CV of per-cell coverage on an 8x6 grid, so it measures how evenly the canopy fills the tray rather than how similar the green pixels are to each other.
dataType: overhead microgreen tray images under even lighting

outputs.name: CanopyCover
outputs.label: Canopy cover
outputs.description: Percentage of tray area covered by foliage

outputs.name: GreennessIndex
outputs.label: Greenness
outputs.description: 1.0 is pure green; falls off as hue moves toward yellow

outputs.name: Uniformity
outputs.label: Spatial evenness
outputs.description: 1 - CV of coverage across an 8x6 grid. 1.0 is perfectly even; a stand dense at one end scores low.

notes: ReadinessScore is a composite convenience metric, not a validated agronomic index. Report CanopyCover and Uniformity alongside it.

commonColumns.Label: Source image title
commonColumns.Unit: Spatial unit of every length/area column
commonColumns.Calibrated: 1 if a scale was applied; 0 means all values are in pixels
